**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2022/03/20 (Sun) 20:33  
[USER] User is interested in advanced networking techniques to improve Wi-Fi signal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advanced networking techniques mentioned include mesh networking and beamforming.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mesh networking is described as a wireless network topology where devices are interconnected, increasing reliability and coverage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mesh networks utilize nodes (access points or routers) to transmit the Wi-Fi signal and optimize paths for signal travel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To implement a mesh network, the user needs to purchase mesh networking devices and configure them, often using an app.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Beamforming is explained as a technique that directs the Wi-Fi signal towards connected devices for faster and more reliable speeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Beamforming is typically built into compatible routers or access points and needs to be enabled in router settings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Both mesh networking and beamforming require additional investment in hardware and setup time.  
[USER] User requests recommendations for specific mesh networking devices or routers that support beamforming.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular mesh networking devices listed include: Google Nest Wifi, Amazon Eero Mesh WiFi System, Netgear Orbi Mesh WiFi System, Linksys Velop Mesh WiFi System, TP-Link Deco Mesh WiFi System.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Routers with beamforming mentioned include: NETGEAR Nighthawk X10 AD7200, ASUS RT-AC88U, TP-Link Archer C5400, Linksys WRT3200ACM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User is advised to research and read reviews before purchasing devices to ensure they meet specific needs.  
[USER] User inquires about affordable options for mesh networking or routers with beamforming.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Affordable options for mesh networking include: TP-Link Deco S4, Tenda Nova MW3, Google Nest WiFi Router.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Budget-friendly routers with beamforming include: TP-Link Archer A7, Netgear R6230, ASUS RT-ACRH13.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User is informed that pricing can vary based on home size, number of devices, and desired performance.  
[USER] User asks for specific features to look for when choosing between mesh networking devices or routers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended features to consider include:  
1. Speed (look for 802.11ac or 802.11ax)  
2. Coverage Area (size of home and number of access points)  
3. Compatibility (with existing devices)  
4. Customer Service and Support
